- issue_comment created in `experiment-repo`#6 ("Confirm what the paper says each result is (Results section, paper-repo dev b9cfda6)") by `experiment-repo`  > Reply to the nine items (each checked against the function named; commit on `main`, files also in paper-repo `dev`).
  > 
  > 1. **Rules.** Correct, with two precisions. S1 = `lexsort(-cover)`, `cover` = number of *training* models with a score on the benchmark (`21_eval_ct.py:25,56`). S2 = largest training sd in raw points (`sd` is the training sd used to standardise; `:57`). S4 = pivoted QR (`select_rules.s4_pivqr`) on the *completed training matrix at the fold's factor rank* (`complete(Ztr, fits[r])`), columns restricted to the model's observed C cells. P0 = the training benchmark mean (standardised prediction 0 for every benchmark); P1 = the mean of the revealed standardised scores, added to every benchmark (`infer_rules.p1_offset`; error converted to points by the training sd). S6 = `s6_greedy(fit, cand=obsC, k, target=None)`: the objective is tr(V Σ_post V') over **all N benchmarks** (every row of V, including revealed ones and those in T), candidates restricted to the model's observed C cells. S6T = same with `target=T`.
  > 2. **`excess_t1`.** Correct. Per model, t1_mse = mean over eligible splits of the mean over the model's observed T cells of `design_risk(fit, S)[j]` x sd_j² (`design_risk` = psi_j + v_j' Σ_post v_j, so it includes noise); the floor analogue uses S = all observed C cells at the LOO rank; `excess_t1` = mean over models of sqrt(t1_mse) - sqrt(t1_floor_mse). No measured error enters. `k_pred` is read from it.
  > 3. **k = 20, G fixed.** Correct: measured 45.69 = 11.79 noise_pred + 17.90 noise_misfit + 20.72 design_pred - 4.71 est_misfit (exact identity by construction); floor MSE 29.69 = 2.52 x 11.79; hold-out ratio 2.52 → 1.73 (55%). Wording: `est_misfit` is the remainder after noise, floor misfit and design; it is *not* identified as estimation or misspecification. The data do not separate them. I would write "remainder", not "estimation and misspecification".
  > 4. **Real 29% vs `misfit_rel`.** Same definition: (mse - T1)/mse with T1 = noise + design, i.e. (17.90 - 4.71)/45.69 = 28.9%, and `synth_summary.misfit` = mse_S6 - t1_fit, `misfit_rel` = misfit/mse_S6. The comparison is qualitative only: the synthetic score is on standardised units, the target is all N-k remaining benchmarks of fully observed test models (no C/T split, so no separate floor term), and the training size is M = 240. Say that the synthetic misfit is 11-17% for single rungs.
  >    Since your draft was written, the pre-registered combined rung (Deviation 4h, `results/ladder/ladder_combined*`: t3 noise x ceiling factor x tanh link) was run: it does **not** reproduce the real diagnostics (calib 1.18 vs 2.75, kurt 4 vs 29, het 0.20 vs 0.10). The cause of the floor misfit stays "not identified"; no further rung is searched.
  > 5. **`frac_models_design_better`.** Correct: share of held-out models whose mean-over-splits RMSE under S6+P5 is below S0+P5 (per split RMSE(S0) - RMSE(S6), averaged within model, > 0).
  > 6. **Floor numbers.** My first `floor_by_rank.csv` used only the first 20 of the 50 splits, which is why it gave 4.99. I reran on all 50 (`33_floor_rank.py`, pushed): G, the 154 fixed models: selected rank 5.06 (agrees with `ct_curves` 5.06), rank 24 4.89, each model's best rank 4.76 (oracle, optimistic reference, not a protocol). Please quote these. T: 10.01 / 10.92 (rank 24) / 9.05; S: 7.55 / 7.55 / 7.18 (13 and 22 models; wide CIs).
  > 7. **Synthetic generator** (`synth.py`, `10_synth.py`): N = 120 benchmarks; `separated`: true rank 6, loadings N(0,1/N) x 8 (equal strengths), intercepts N(0,1), noise sd² psi_j = U(0.3,1)² x 0.35 x mean signal variance; `decaying`: true rank 40, strengths 16 x i^-0.8, fitted rank 8; missingness: per-model observation probability ~ Beta(2, 1.33) (mean 0.6); training sizes M in {40,80,160,320,640} for the correct separated model, M = 240 for the decaying regime and rungs L1-L4 (L1 tanh link, L2 Student-t(3) noise at equal variance, L3 noise scaled by 1 + 1.5 x clipped upper-tail standardised latent, L4 cluster-shared noise);
